name: Western Energy Systems
old_description: Western Energy Systems is a distributor and systems integrator of combined heat and power (CHP) and distributed generation solutions, including switchgear. Offers fuel gas compressors, battery storage and other power systems, serving utility, commercial and industrial clients.
about:
Western Energy Systems, operating as Northeast-Western Energy Systems USA, LLC (NES-WES), is headquartered in Brea, California. The company traces its roots to 1964 and has accumulated over 50 years of experience in reciprocating engine power applications. In 2023, the business was acquired by the INNIO Group, adding the resources of the Jenbacher product line to its portfolio.

NES-WES functions as a distributor and systems integrator for combined heat and power (CHP) and distributed generation (DG) solutions. The firm engineers and integrates complete systems ranging from 50 kW to 22 MW, incorporating Jenbacher gas engine-generators with balance-of-plant components such as heat recovery, fuel gas handling, emissions control, cooling, chillers, enclosures, switchgear, transformers, and power plant controls. A staff of 200–499 employees handles integration engineering, field project management, commissioning, and ongoing maintenance.

The company serves institutional, commercial, and governmental customers across the energy, utility, industrial, and commercial sectors. Project references include the Bergen County Wastewater Treatment plant, Covidien’s New Haven CHP installation, Mount Joy Wire, a landfill-gas-to-energy facility, High Sierra California Cogeneration, and Techni-Cast industrial cogeneration.

NES-WES emphasizes reducing energy costs, increasing resilience, and lowering carbon footprints for its clients. The 2023 acquisition by INNIO Jenbacher is cited as strengthening its capabilities in the power generation and microgrid markets, while the company’s approach balances innovative solutions with time-tested engineering practices.
